usedFor: Shopify holds your products and Superthread holds your projects, so “New Product” can run “Create Project”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create Project” in Superthread
bestTemplate.why: Each new product opens a Superthread project, so launch tasks have a home from the start.

watchOut: “Create Project” takes list, dates, members and owner, so set them once and every product gets the same.
